title: Film Independent Documentary Story Lab and Producing Lab
summary: Two week-long documentary labs: the Story Lab (spring) for directors of nonfiction features in post-production, focused on structure and editing, and the Producing Lab (each fall) for producers with nonfiction features at any stage, focused on financing, finishing and release.
deadlineNote: Application dates are on each lab's own page.
eligibility: Nonfiction feature projects; Film Independent says labs are open to all filmmakers regardless of background or experience.
